kurz: The starch has swollen too far: the pasta cooked too long or kept cooking in the heat afterwards.
bild_im_kopf: Like a bread roll left too long in the soup.

ursachen.warum: The starch keeps [[quellen|swelling]] until the centre has no bite left.
fix: Taste a minute before the packet time

ursachen.warum: Hot pasta in a colander or in hot sauce keeps cooking even off the heat.
fix: Serve with the sauce straight away

ursachen.warum: If pasta goes into merely hot water, the surface dissolves before it sets and turns slimy.
fix: Add only at a rolling boil

q1.frage: Did you stick to the cooking time on the packet?

q2.frage: Did the pasta then sit for a while in the colander or sauce?
